newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Ceylon Glass up 2 pct on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Ceylon Glass up 2 pct on growth prospects.

text.p: Shares of Ceylon Glass Co Ltd rose 2.33 percent or 50 cents to 22 rupees in early Thursday trade on growth prospects for 1997, brokers said.
"The company's growth prospects in 1997 which were good are expected to improve after the reserve ratio cut," said a local broker.
The Central Bank cut the reserve requirement of commercial banks by two percent on Monday in a bid to reduce the cost of corporate borrowings.
Ceylon Glass is Sri Lanka's main manufacturer of glass bottles and packing containers.
